integrity: Exact coefficient formula proved; aperiodic two-dimensional saddle and stationary critical-density expansion proved. Finite checker corroborates selected values, not infinity. No independent audit or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure monadic first-order logic with equality, independent equiprobable predicate values, two deterministic equal domain sizes, fixed quantifier rank and positive limiting sample-to-type ratio. A general occupancy LDP may cover part of the exponential rate, and exhaustive historical priority has not been established.
title: Exact bounded-rank logical collision asymptotics for random monadic structures
